copied_from: STUDIES/real_target_path_metric_v1/protocol.json (WP4b, SHA-256 9ac8722cec8941f0260a262193f352cfdeb30ddf0917e358f3e16cf9f31ca9cb); only the fixture set, seeds (now a list), arms (I and P only) and gates additions changed

target.coordinates: triangular unit-Jacobian centeredness map, a in {0.75, 1}

starts.rule: initial_innovations plus mu offsets, zero sigma offsets; cold-initialization factor of sspd-11 deliberately not applied

P.globals_block: BidiagonalCholesky diag sqrt(geomean over chains of arm I adapted momentum covariance for globals), zero subdiagonal
P.path_block: BidiagonalCholesky = Cholesky of H = [1/tau^2 at x_1] + Q_rw(sigma_x) + diag((nu+1)/(nu*(alpha^2+beta^2 s_t^2+gamma^2/(v_t+1)))) at initial_params globals (nu=3, beta=e^-2)

gates.confirmation_rule: an arm is confirmed only if every one of the three seeds passes all per-run gates (R-hat, bulk/tail ESS, zero div/invalid/exhaustion, cap rate) and, for P, every seed also passes agreement with I (same seed) and with N

efficiency.statistic: min over the eight functionals of bulk ESS per retained target call; ratio P/I per seed; geometric mean and range over seeds

predictions: P passes all gates on 3/3 seeds (confirmed)
I passes all gates on 3/3 seeds (confirmed)
P/I min-bulk-ESS-per-call ratio geometric mean >= 2 (WP4b single seed: 2.8)
P agrees with I and with N on every functional (|z| <= 3) on every seed
P median depth 6 (as WP4b), I median depth 8 with cap rate <= 1%
